about: Labelled (claim, quote) pairs for the type-grounding judge (scripts/grounding.py). grounded=false are mention-only traps: the quote names the entity (or its type word) without grounding the TYPE claim. grounded=true are quotes a too-strict judge must still accept. The first 20 cases were written by hand before any judge ran; one keeps the shape of a real failure from the 2026-11-18 artifact (it was copied from a private repository's document, so its names were replaced before publication and the set was re-run on both judges). 3 cases added 2026-11-25 pin contract clarifications found in a 273-assertion hand audit (implicit object, endpoints-only mention, roadmap item). 5 more added the same day, when the build's name/endpoint pre-reject was dropped in favour of the judge: two grounded cases whose quote does not spell the name (an extractor-coined label under the document's own wording), and three the judge must still reject without that rule (a quote about ANOTHER instance of the type, as entity and as relation, and a mention that names nobody).
